weekly_objective: Protect recovery through the conference travel block by keeping all remaining rides easy-to-moderate MTB within override limits, deferring quality work until fatigue markers improve.
coach_says: TSB has dropped 16 points since Sunday and your HRV, resting HR trend, and Garmin recovery status all point the same direction — you're still digging out from Tuesday's double even though the numbers on paper look 'manageable.' Given the conference override already restricts Thu-Sat to short AM MTB anyway, I've used that natural cap to full advantage: Friday's tempo intervals are shelved in favour of an easy spin, and Saturday/Sunday are trimmed slightly to keep the week net-recovering rather than net-loading. Sunday's long ride survives but shorter, and the aerobic-high gap will get proper attention once you're back to baseline.

days.details: 45 min restorative/yin-style flow at lunch. Focus: hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine, and 5 min of diaphragmatic breathing to finish. No loading today — readiness is 32 with ~30h recovery time outstanding, and tomorrow is your committed double hard day. Weather is drizzly and windy anyway. Goal: arrive at Tuesday as fresh as possible.

days.session: AM hills ride + PM hard MTB group ride (committed double)
days.details: AM (60 min | Threshold hills | Zone 3-4): Warm up 15 min Zone 2, then 3 x 8 min sustained climbing at Zone 3 high to Zone 4 low (RPE 7-8), 5 min easy spinning between efforts, cool down 10 min Zone 1. Ride the climbs seated and steady — this targets your aerobic-high shortage, so avoid surging above threshold. Wet and windy forecast: mudguards, layers, and pick sheltered climbs. PM (90 min | Hard MTB group ride | Zone 4-5 bursts): Non-negotiable committed session. Ride it as it comes, but given anaerobic load is already above target, resist contesting every sprint — sit in where you can. Fuel well between sessions (carbs within 30 min of the AM ride) and prioritise an early night.

Lunch swim, ~1000m total, purely recovery flush after yesterday's double. Warmup: 200m easy freestyle, focus on long strokes. Main set: 4 x 100m easy freestyle at RPE 3-4 with 20s rest, then 4 x 50m drill (catch-up or single-arm) with 15s rest. Cooldown: 200m very easy mixed strokes. No hard efforts at all — this is circulation and range of motion before travelling to the conference this evening. Wettest day of the week, so the pool is the right call.

days.session: Zone 2 endurance MTB (conference, AM only, shortened)
days.details: 75 min | Aerobic base | Zone 2, RPE 3-4, conversational throughout. Morning ride within the 2h conference window. Choose flowing, non-technical trails and keep power/HR capped in Zone 2 — spin up climbs seated, no punchy efforts. Trimmed 15 min off the original plan: TSB has fallen sharply since Sunday, HRV is poor, resting HR is trending up, and Garmin flags you as strained. Today is pure easy aerobic volume, nothing more. Wet forecast: allow extra time for bike cleaning, and cut to 60 min if trails are badly waterlogged.

days.session: Easy MTB spin (tempo shelved due to declining recovery)
days.details: 85 min | Aerobic base | Zone 1-2, RPE 3-4, fully conversational. Originally planned as tempo intervals to target the aerobic-high shortage, but with TSB down 16 points since Sunday, HRV still poor, resting HR rising, and anaerobic load already over target, this is not the week to add quality. Ride flowing trails or fire roads, seated spin, no efforts above Zone 2 regardless of how good the legs feel in the clear weather. If HRV/readiness clearly rebound by Friday morning, you may hold a slightly firmer Zone 2-3 pace on climbs, but do not chase intervals — save that for next week once recovered.

days.session: Easy trail spin (conference, AM only, trimmed)
days.details: 60 min | Recovery/easy aerobic | Zone 1-2, RPE 2-3. Morning ride, well within the 2h limit, shortened slightly from the original 75 min to keep the deload going ahead of Sunday. Relaxed trail riding — soft-pedal, high cadence, freewheel the descents, no efforts. Drizzle and wind forecast, so keep it short and enjoyable rather than forcing distance. This buffers recovery between Friday's easy ride and Sunday's longer ride.

days.session: Long endurance MTB before travelling home (shortened)
days.details: 2 hrs | Long aerobic endurance | Zone 2, RPE 3-4. Shortened from the original 2.5 hrs — recovery has continued to decline through the week (TSB down 16 pts, HRV poor, resting HR rising), so protecting the long ride means trimming it rather than cancelling it. Ride continuously in Zone 2, seated climbing, minimal coasting, fuelling every 45 min (60g carbs/hr). No intervals: quality quota for the week was Tuesday only, given Friday's tempo was shelved. Stronger winds and returning drizzle mean an earlier or more sheltered route is wise. Finish with enough margin to clean up and travel home in the evening — if legs feel heavy, cap it at 90 minutes.
